name: ADIDAS ADIPOWER MULTIWEIGHT 3.3
description: Adidas Adipower Multiweight 3.3, more speed and control.  Designed for high-level padel players who practice the sport frequently and intensely, the Adidas Adipower Multiweight 3.3 provides superb control on fast movements. It has a rounded shape, low balance and a centered sweet spot, making it ideal if you are looking for improved control and easy maneuverability. Due to the weight system located on the rail of the edge Weight & Balance System Multiweight, this padel racket has the particularity of being able to modify its weight, adding up to 9 grams distributed in 7 screws, to adapt the balance to the needs of the moment. Optimized resistance In terms of materials, the frame is made of carbon fiber, while the faces are made of 18K carbon fiber interwoven filaments. This material guarantees great durability, rigidity and resistance. On the other hand, in the core we find the high density EVA High Memory rubber, a foam that stands out for providing supreme power in the fastest strokes. Full of effect hits It also has an inner carbon rib in the frame called Power Embossed Ridge, which is responsible for increasing the rigidity of the structure. Thanks to the Dual Exoskeleton, the frame and the heart of the padel racket are reinforced so that the player can exert more force on each stroke. In the same way, to improve durability it includes the Structural Reinforcement, which consists of perimeter reinforcements that resist high torsion. And with the intention that the player can hit the ball with much more effect and be able to surprise their opponents more easily, it incorporates the Spin Blade Decal relief and the Smart Holes Curve, an arrangement of the holes designed to facilitate the use of effects.

name: ADIDAS CROSS IT CTRL
description:
Adidas Cross IT CTRL 2024, control padel racket for professionals.
The new Adidas Cross IT CTRL 2024 is a racket designed to adapt to the needs of those padel players who have a high level of play and seek to improve their performance to reach their maximum level.
This model has a round shape with a low balance and a sweet spot located in the center of the padel racket. This ensures excellent control, as the weight leans towards the grip. You will hit with greater precision, even on the most difficult balls.
High-quality materials
The faces of the Cross IT CTRL are made of Carbon Aluminized 15K, interwoven filaments of 15k carbon fiber that increase the flexibility, strength and durability of the padel racket.
The core, meanwhile, has been made with High Memory EVA rubber , a high density foam that increases the power in the blows in the red, faster. It is recommended for players with a higher technical level.
And, as regards the frame, carbon fiber has been used, a material that adds lightness and strength to the padel racket. It dampens vibrations and perfectly balances power and control in the stroke.
Better performance on the court
If we focus on technologies, this Adidas 2024 padel racket incorporates the Spin Blade Mold in its planes, which consists of a roughness with 3D relief that increases the grip of the ball so that it spins with more effect.
It also has the Dynamic Air Flower, which ensures a continuous flow of air in the heart area to improve the maneuverability of the padel racket. In addition, a longer handle length thanks to Power Extra Grip technology, generates more inertia and raises the sweet spot.
It also includes Structural Reinforcement, a durability technology that generates greater resistance to high torsion through perimeter reinforcements.

originalData.Description:
A light and manageable padel racket, this is the Stima Spirit 2023 from Babolat.
The new Babolat Stima Spirit is an extremely lightweight racket, weighing only 335 grams, which makes it a very manageable racket, allowing great freedom of movement around the padel racket. Your game will be agile and dynamic, as you will be able to reach those impossible balls during matches.
This padel racket has been designed for women with a good level of play, whether advanced or professional, who are looking for a model that offers great maneuverability and optimal comfort. It has a feminine and modern design, which will make your game look splendid.
Lightweight and flexible materials for good comfort when hitting.
If we talk about the materials that make up this padel racket, we must mention the Black EVA rubber inside, a very elastic foam that allows you to hit the ball with more comfort and power while offering perfect shock absorption and greater durability.
It is also worth mentioning the Soft Fiber on the outside, soft and flexible fibers that will allow you to achieve excellent power with little effort.
State-of-the-art technology
The Stima Spirit 2023 incorporates an innovative technology patented by Babolat, in which the most rigid areas of the head of the padel racket have been microperforated to add lightness and expand the optimal hitting area.
In order to reduce vibrations after impacts and provide more comfort in the shots, the Vibrabsorb System technology has been incorporated, which consists of integrating elastomer in the graphite of the heart of this padel racket.
In addition, the Holes Pattern System technology has been incorporated to achieve greater transmission of precision and powerwhen returning shots. And, to achieve more spin on the ball, it has the  3D Spin technology, which will allow you to increase the effects that the ball can catch.

name: BLACK CARBON VARLION CAÑON DIFFUSER 2023
description:
Varlion Cañon Difusor Carbon Black, elegance without equal.
The aesthetics of the new Cañon Difusor Carbon Black 2023 padel racket from Varlion is extremely elegant due to the combination of black and dark purple colors, which incorporates the SOFTCOLOR colored rubber and makes the racket stand out for its attractive and distinguished appearance.
It belongs to the Black range.
It incorporates the DIFFUSOR WINGS, a new technology that provides control in the blows to reduce vibrations, achieves greater regularity and consistency in the blow, as well as impacts with greater speed.
The texture of the planes is rough because it includes SLICE technology, designed to make the ball grip better and take more spin, achieving more spin.
In addition, the Varlion Cañon Black 2023 includes the AERODYNAMIC DRILLING, a system of holes designed to reduce vibrations, giving the padel racket a greater resistance to hit evenly.
It also incorporates a HEXAGON adhesive protector, designed and manufactured in an injection mold in a low hardness PTU. It has been placed on the frame of the padel racket and absorbs shocks and scratches to increase the durability and lifespan of the racket.
HEXAGON is also the frame of this padel racket, a hexagonal frame that gives greater strength, firmness and rigidity to the racket by means of a rib with a chamfered part and a straight part.
Ideal if you are looking for exceptional power
It has a diamond shape with high balance, so its strong point is the power. The player benefits from this feature, especially in offensive shots.
Its core is made of EVA HYPERSOFT rubber, medium hardness. The heart of this padel racket has been reinforced with carbon fiber and has also been impregnated with VAR-FLEX, an epoxy resin exclusive to Varlion that gives the racket unbeatable elasticity and resistance.

name: BULLPADEL HACK 02
description:
Bullpadel Hack 02, Racket OF Paquito Navarro
The Bullpadel Hack 02 is the weapon of Paquito Navarro. The Racket Hack from Bullpadel features a new format, with greater reaction, control, and potencia than its predecessor. It arrives loaded and ready to take down all its rivals.

Player Type
The Bullpadel Hack is created for players with a professional or advanced level, who are looking for a Racket with a lot of potencia, with a high balance and extraordinary technologies that enhance the sensations on the court.

Technical Characteristics
It features Tricarbon carbon, achieving more reaction in the hit. This led to a redesign of the frame, expanding the sweet spot, providing greater control to the speed of our game. This technology combined with its new format, we obtain a Racket hibrida with maximum potencia without losing control of the game's speed.
The Tricarbon is a new carbon developed by the brand Bullpadel, which due to its three-directional weave, allows the use of finer and lighter fiber, which will provide us with greater reaction when acting. Its core is created in MultiEva rubber and for its frame Carbontube in 100% carbon fiber. They have incorporated a new Protector Metalshield that perfectly adapts to the Customweight weight plate system, which allows modifying the balance of the Racket according to the needs of each player.
This Bullpadel Hack 02 also features a Vibradrive system for vibration absorption, a Hack heart with Nano Paint aesthetics to give it a more vibrant color, and Nerve channels on the side of the Racket. But as a novelty for this Racket Hack, we will find an innovative grip Hesacore that improves grip by reducing the effort and pressure we exert with the hand, preventing future injuries.

Design and Colors
The truth is that the external appearance of the Racket also gives much to talk about. This year, the design has been completely renewed, the Racket of Paquito Navarro has left behind the orange color to present a striking green color. The base in black and the details with different shades of green, blue, and yellow make up one of the most attractive designs for a Racket. We know that for many players, the taste for a Racket begins from the first look, which is why Bullpadel has also focused on creating attractive, unique, and different designs from the rest of the competition.

Summary of the Racket
In summary, we can say that this is one of the most incredible rackets on the market, and not only because it is used by one of the best players in the world but because of its quality. A complete Racket in every sense, high-quality materials like carbon, state-of-the-art technologies like Vibradrive, and a design that quickly catches the eye. A Racket that if you are a demanding player and play with potencia, you cannot miss.

Bullpadel Rackets - Quality with Guarantee
We recommend taking a look at the entire Bullpadel racket collection for the 2020 season. One of the largest collections that includes rackets for all playing styles and levels. If we talk about another specific Racket, and that we can recommend, it would be the new Racket Hack control 20, a Racket that like the new weapon of Paquito Navarro, is made with the most resistant carbon; the big difference is that it is a Racket intended for control players.

name: BULLPADEL HACK 03 2023
description:
Bullpadel Hack 03 2023, prints the maximum power

High performance with absolute control

name: BULLPADEL VERTEX 03 2023
description:
Bullpadel Vertex 03 2023, deploys a powerful game
The Bullpadel Vertex 03 2023 is a high performance padel racket that has been designed for adult players who have an advanced or professional level, who have a correct physical and technical preparation. It has a weight between 365 and 375 grams.
It has a diamond shape with a high balance and a reduced and elevated sweet spot towards the top of the padel racket. These characteristics translate on the court in an extreme power in offensive shots such as in the auctions, which also generates a leverage effect that will turn your shots into unstoppable attacks.
Includes the innovative HESACORE grip.
The inner core is made of MULTIEVA rubber, which consists of two layers with different densities, one compact and one with a lower density, which allows you to react with a powerful ball output against fast balls and get maximum control on slow balls.

On top of the METAL SHIELD protector is the CUSTOM WEIGHT, which allows the weight of the padel racket to be modified to adapt to the needs of each player, whether offering more balance, power or control.
In order to reduce vibrations after an impact, Bullpadel has added to this model the VIBRADRIVE technology, a fist mounting system that inserts an elastic rubber piece.

name: HEAD EVO EXTREME 2025
description:
Head Evo Extreme 2025
The Evo Extreme from the new 2025 collection by Head is designed for players who are just starting in the world of padel. Thanks to its reduced weight of 350 grams, it allows for easy movement and quicker reactions with each hit, helping to build confidence from the first match. Additionally, its modern and bold design gives it a contemporary touch that stands out on the court.

Confort and Ease of Use
One of the most appreciated aspects of this model is its elastic rubber core, which responds smoothly to impact and expands the effective hitting area. This means that even off-center hits feel more comfortable and easier to control. Added to this is the fiberglass surface, a lightweight and flexible material that provides a more pleasant and less demanding ball output than carbon, perfect for players in the learning stage.

Main Technologies and Features

    Teardrop shape for a good balance between control and power.
    Lightweight for improved maneuverability.
    Soft rubber core offering great comfort.
    Renewed fiberglass, flexible and lightweight.
    Innegra™ technology, which absorbs vibrations and provides stability.
    Reinforced frame for greater power in smashes.
    Extreme design, modern and striking.


A Racket Made to Grow with You
The Head Evo Extreme 2025 is not only designed to learn to play but also to progress quickly. Its combination of comfort, lightness, and controlled power makes it the perfect companion for training, enjoying, and improving match by match. With it, you will have the confidence you need to take your first steps in padel and the assurance to continue advancing towards a more offensive game.

Don’t wait a second longer and start your padel journey with the new EVO SPEED 2023 racket by HEAD. It can provide you with great performance on the court, and with it you’ll start playing with great technique from the very beginning.

name: NOX ML10 BAHIA LUXURY SERIES
description:
Nox Ml10 Bahía Luxury Series: Elite performance for demanding players
The Nox Ml10 Bahía Luxury Series is a racket designed for those seeking the best in technology, power, and control. An exclusive piece within the Luxury range, created for professionals and advanced players who demand precision in every point.

Design and Balance
Its teardrop shape ensures a perfect balance between power and control, allowing for powerful smashes and stable defense. This balance makes the Bahía a versatile and comprehensive racket, ideal for those seeking an offensive game without sacrificing control.

Carbon 12k: Guaranteed power and Durability
The Carbon 12k structure provides rigidity and resistance, ensuring powerful hits with excellent response. This material, along with Nox's advanced manufacturing technology, offers extra durability to withstand the most demanding playing conditions.

HR3 Rubber: Unique Sensations in Every Hit
The core is composed of Black EVA HR3 rubber, known for its excellent recovery capacity. This material allows for great ball output, providing a firm and comfortable feel, while also reducing vibrations to protect the joints.

Rough Surface for Extreme Effects
The double-textured rough impact surface (hexagon relief and sand) of the racket enhances spin shots, improving slices, viboras, and topspin smashes. A key detail for players looking to add extra rotation to their shots.

Exclusive Design and Luxury Finishes
The Bahía features a sophisticated design, belonging to the prestigious Luxury Series range. Every detail reflects quality and style, designed for those who value aesthetics as much as performance.

The Nox Ml10 Bahía Luxury Series is not just a racket, it is the perfect choice for professional players who want technology, power, and control in a single tool.

name: Nox Ml10 LIMITED EDITION 2023
description:
New and exclusive Nox ML10 Limited Edition 2023
The new ML10 Limited Edition 2023 racket is an exclusive model from the new Nox collection, which has been specifically designed for advanced or professional players looking for a resistant and durable racket.
It is round with a low balance and a large, wide contact point, characteristics which provide the player with great comfort, control, and safety when hitting the ball.
Greater spin, achieving a balance between power and control
This Miguel Lamperti racket, which weighs between 360 and 375 grams, has a frame made of 100% carbon fibre, which provides the racket with greater rigidity and durability.
The faces of this Nox racket are made with 18K Carbon, a fabric which makes the racket light through the use of interwoven carbon microfilaments. This material, which is rigid and firm, stands out due to its rigidity which allows for an explosive aggressiveness.
It has an HR3 rubber core, a high-density foam that has a great memory-effect, which accelerates the recovery process to the racket’s original shape after an impact.
With a Smartstrap system to replace the strap
In terms of technologies, the Nox ML10 Limited Edition incorporates the Exclusive SPIN + system, which provides a dual rough finish that is responsible for ensuring better contact with the ball when striking it, as well as greater spin.
In addition, the frame incorporates Dynamic Composit Structure (DCS) technology, which reduces the difference in hardness between the frame and the racket’s faces. Therefore, if the player hits the ball with the outside of the racket, the risk of damage to the fibres when the rubber dips is reduced.

description:
Nox Ml10 Pro Cup 3K Luxury Series: Performance and Sensations on the Court
The Nox Ml10 Pro Cup Luxury Series EX is a padel racket that was created as a tribute to the most iconic model of Miguel Lamperti. Preserving the spirit of the classic Ml10 Pro Cup, this special edition is designed to offer a perfect balance between control and potencia.

Thanks to its round shape, it provides a wide sweet spot that ensures great precision even on off-center shots. This racket is aimed at players of all levels who seek firm sensations, absolute control, and measured potencia when approaching the net. Its behavior stands out for a predictable response, great ball output, and outstanding comfort in every exchange.

Highlighted Technologies

    HR3 Core core: High-density rubber that improves recovery after the hit, generating greater potencia without losing control.
    100% carbon frame: Greater structural rigidity that translates into durability and stability during play.
    Faces with 2 layers of fiberglass + 1 metallic: The ideal balance between elasticity and firmness. Provides an intermediate feel that facilitates control without sacrificing attacking sensations.
    Dynamic Composit Structure: Technology that optimizes the connection between frame and faces, minimizing the risk of breakage and maximizing durability.
    Luxury Series: Premium details and high-end finishes that enhance the aesthetics and overall performance of the racket.


Design and Player Profile
The sober and elegant design with metallic details pays tribute to a padel legend. It is aimed at players who prioritize control without giving up occasional potencia. Whether you are a beginner, intermediate, or advanced player, this racket will provide you with a complete, comfortable, and precise playing experience.

originalData.Description:
Why choose the Softee Pro Master Evolution racket?

  The Softee padel racket features a contact point in the middle of the faces that offers greater strength and balance. In addition, the brand used high quality materials to achieve the best performance on the court, such as fiberglass, both in the frame area and on the faces.

What type of player is the Softee Pro Master Evolution padel racket for?

  This racket is ideal for intermediate players who need great resistance, since the entire perimeter is reinforced to achieve a more solid structure with a softer touch.

Design and colors

  It has a striking and elegant black design, with yellow details like the brand's logo and in the lower area of the frame. And it has a teardrop shape that facilitates better shots and ball contact.

Technical characteristics of the Softee Pro Master Evolution racket

 
It facilitates a versatile type of game that provides an optimal balance between strength and control in each attack. 
With a glossy finish and smooth surface that conveys great power in shots and better spin. 
With an anti-vibration handle that prevents wrist or elbow discomfort from powerful impacts. 
It has an EVA soft rubber core that delivers quick recovery from impacts, as well as a better feel. 
The heart area has been reinforced to provide greater stability and prevent arm twisting or injuries.
